title: Building an Agentic Platform — Ben Kus, CTO Box
talk_summary: Box's CTO describes replacing brittle single-shot LLM extraction with an agentic directed-graph pipeline (field grouping, multi-query, tool double-checks, multi-model voting, LLM-as-judge with retry feedback) to fix accuracy on complex documents. Key lessons: keep the agentic abstraction layer separate from distributed-systems scaling, prefer prompts/cached prompts/agenticness over fine-tuning, and maintain eval sets plus a harder 'challenge' eval set.

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of an LLM judge that only scores, the judge returns actionable feedback and the agent retries before output reaches the user.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a judge to tell you uh hey uh here's some feedback, keep trying

takeaways.what_they_do: For difficult items, query models from different vendors and take agreement as signal.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Three models from different vendors, two of them think this is the answer. That was probably a good answer.

takeaways.what_they_do: Maintain a normal eval set plus a deliberately harder 'challenge' set of rare-but-hard cases to test headroom, alongside LLM-as-judge and human feedback.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we created a challenge set of of eval sets to so that we can better explore like things that not everybody asked

takeaways.what_they_do: Group related fields so one agent handles interdependent items together, then split work into multiple queries over the document rather than one giant prompt.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if there's like a set of fields that are like customers ... you need the AI to handle those together

takeaways.what_they_do: Avoid fine-tuning because every model upgrade forces re-tuning; instead invest in prompts, cached prompts, and agentic structure.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we use use prompts or cache prompts or agenticness as opposed to fine-tuning

takeaways.technique: Separate agentic layer from scaling layer
takeaways.what_they_do: Keep the agentic graph design distinct from the distributed-systems/scaling concerns so each can evolve independently.
takeaways.evidence_quote: being able to separate these two systems into like somebody who thinks about the agentic framework and somebody who thinks about the the how to scale
